title: Two killed after small plane crashes into house in Germany
summary_full: A light aircraft crashed into a house roof in Ganderkesee, Germany. Two men, aged sixty-five and seventy-seven, were killed in the accident. Authorities conducted a complex recovery operation to remove the embedded wreckage. Residents of the affected home were evacuated during the emergency response. German officials have initiated an investigation into the cause of the crash.
